subject: math
question: 设矩阵 $A = \begin{pmatrix} 2 & 2 & a \\ 2 & 5 & -4 \\ -2 & -4 & 5 \end{pmatrix}$ 有一个二重特征值，记 $\lambda_{1}$ 是 $A$ 的最小特征值， $\boldsymbol{\beta} = (t, 1, -1)^{\mathrm{T}}$ 。确定 $a$ 的值，并求解线性方程组 $(\lambda_{1} I - A) X = \boldsymbol{\beta}$ 。

steps.text:
分析 需求出 A 的特征值，才能确定 $\lambda_{1}$ 与 a 的值；再求解线性方程组.

$$
\begin{array}{r l} & {\left| \lambda I - A \right| = \left| \begin{array}{c c c} \lambda - 2 & - 2 & - a \\ - 2 & \lambda - 5 & 4 \\ 2 & 4 & \lambda - 5 \end{array} \right| = - \left| \begin{array}{c c c} 2 & 4 & \lambda - 5 \\ - 2 & \lambda - 5 & 4 \\ \lambda - 2 & - 2 & - a \end{array} \right|} \\ & {\quad = - \left| \begin{array}{c c c} 2 & 4 & \lambda - 5 \\ 0 & \lambda - 1 & \lambda - 1 \\ 0 & - 2 (\lambda - 1) & - \frac {1}{2} (\lambda - 5) (\lambda - 2) - a \end{array} \right| = (\lambda - 1) \left| \begin{array}{c c} 1 & \lambda - 1 \\ 4 & (\lambda - 5) (\lambda - 2) + 2 a \end{array} \right|} \\ & {\quad = (\lambda - 1) \left[ \lambda^ {2} - 1 1 \lambda + 2 (a + 7) \right].} \end{array}
$$

若 $a = -2$ ，则 $\left|\lambda I - A\right| = (\lambda -1)^2 (\lambda -10)$ ， $A$ 有二重特征值 $\lambda_{1} = 1$

若 $a = \frac{1}{2}\left(\frac{11}{2}\right)^2 - 7 = \frac{65}{8}$ ，则 $\left|\lambda I - A\right| = (\lambda - 1)\left(\lambda - \frac{11}{2}\right)^2$ ， $A$ 有二重特征值 $\lambda_2 = \frac{11}{2}$ .

所以 $a = -2$ 或 $a = \frac{65}{8}$

当 $a = -2$ 时，

$$
\left(\lambda_ {1} \boldsymbol {E} - \boldsymbol {A}, \boldsymbol {\beta}\right) = \left( \begin{array}{c c c c} - 1 & - 2 & 2 & t \\ - 2 & - 4 & 4 & 1 \\ 2 & 4 & - 4 & - 1 \end{array} \right).
$$

显然，当 $t \neq \frac{1}{2}$ 时， $\operatorname{rank}(\lambda_1 I - A, \beta) = 2 \neq \operatorname{rank}(\lambda_1 I - A) = 1$ ，所给方程组无解；

当 $t = \frac{1}{2}$ 时， $\operatorname{rank}(\lambda_1 I - A, \beta) = \operatorname{rank}(\lambda_1 I - A) = 1$ ，方程组有无穷多解，其同解方程组为

$$
x _ {1} + 2 x _ {2} - 2 x _ {3} = - \frac {1}{2}.
$$

对应齐次方程的通解为 $\begin{pmatrix} x_1 \\ x_2 \\ x_3 \end{pmatrix} = k_1 \begin{pmatrix} -2 \\ 1 \\ 0 \end{pmatrix} + k_2 \begin{pmatrix} 2 \\ 0 \\ 1 \end{pmatrix}$ ; 非齐次方程的一个特解为 $X_0 = \begin{pmatrix} -1/2 \\ 0 \\ 0 \end{pmatrix}$ .

原方程组的通解为

$$
\pmb {X} = k _ {1} \left( \begin{array}{c} {- 2} \\ {1} \\ {0} \end{array} \right) + k _ {2} \left( \begin{array}{c} {2} \\ {0} \\ {1} \end{array} \right) + \left( \begin{array}{c} {- 1 / 2} \\ {0} \\ {0} \end{array} \right) \quad (k _ {1}, k _ {2} \text {为任意常数}).
$$

当 $a = \frac{65}{8}$ 时，

$$
\left(\lambda_ {1} \boldsymbol {I} - \boldsymbol {A}, \boldsymbol {\beta}\right) = \left( \begin{array}{c c c c} - 1 & - 2 & - 6 5 / 8 & t \\ - 2 & - 4 & 4 & 1 \\ 2 & 4 & - 4 & - 1 \end{array} \right).
$$

无论 $t$ 为何值，均有 $\operatorname{rank}(\lambda_1 I - A, \beta) = \operatorname{rank}(\lambda_1 I - A) = 2$ ，方程组有无穷多解。其同解方程组为 $\left\{ \begin{array}{l} 8x_1 + 16x_2 + 65x_3 = -8t, \\ 81x_3 = 4. \end{array} \right.$

对应齐次方程组的通解为 $\begin{pmatrix} x_1 \\ x_2 \\ x_3 \end{pmatrix} = k \begin{pmatrix} -2 \\ 1 \\ 0 \end{pmatrix}$ ; 非齐次方程的一个特解为 $X_1 = \begin{pmatrix} -\frac{65}{162} - t \\ 0 \\ \frac{4}{81} \end{pmatrix}$ .

原方程组的通解为

$X = k\left( \begin{array}{c} - 2\\ 1\\ 0 \end{array} \right) + X_{1}$ （ $k$ 为任意常数).
